text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "in Switzerland the president is not the head of state", "gist": "Swiss president is not the head of state"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "full Federal Council", "gist": "Swiss governing body"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "it is extremely rare for all seven members to travel abroad together", "gist": "Full Federal Council rarely travels abroad together"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "the few exceptions being the opening of the Simplon tunnel in Domodossola in 1906 and occasional stopovers during Federal Council outings", "gist": "Exceptions include Simplon tunnel opening in 1906 and some stopovers"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "formulations such as ‘the president is paying a state visit to’ or ‘is currently on a state visit abroad’ are incorrect from a Swiss perspective", "gist": "Phrases describing Swiss president as 'paying a state visit' are incorrect"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "it is more accurate to speak of a ‘presidential visit’", "gist": "Term 'presidential visit' is more accurate for Swiss president"}]}
